title: Second Epistle of Peter
context: These blocks come from the Second Epistle of Peter in the Westcott-Hort Greek New Testament: a Koine Greek letter of exhortation and warning against false teachers, with elevated, sometimes rare vocabulary, long periods, and close parallels to the Epistle of Jude. Some opening words are printed in capitals in this edition; interpret them by meaning. Keep the structure of long periods visible in literal translations, and divide them naturally in prose without losing any clause. Do not reproduce the wording of a particular English Bible.
